title: Import students
description: Add many students at once from a CSV file.
accessDenied: You do not have permission to import students.

file.heading: Choose the CSV file
file.label: Student list (CSV file)
file.description: The first row must hold column names. One student per row.
file.sampleBody: Download the sample, fill in your students, save it as CSV and choose it here.

headerErrors.EMPTY: This file has no column names in its first row.
headerErrors.DUPLICATE_HEADERS: Two columns in this file have the same name. Rename one and choose the file again.
headerErrors.UNREADABLE: This file could not be read. Save it again as CSV and retry.

target.heading: Choose the class
target.description: Every student in the file joins this class. The admission number is created for any row that leaves it empty.
target.noStandards: This academic year has no standards yet.
target.noSections: This standard has no sections yet.

columns.heading: Match the columns
columns.description: Tell us what each column of your file holds. Columns already named like a field are matched for you.
columns.autoMatched: Matched by its name. It can be changed to another field but not left out.
columns.duplicate: More than one column is matched to: {fields}. Choose one.

fields.social_category: Social category (GENERAL, SC, ST, OBC, EWS)

startFailed: The import could not be started. Please try again.
fileUsed: This file has already been imported. Choose the file again to import it once more.

progress.heading: Importing students
progress.leaveNote: You can leave this page. The import keeps running, and this link shows its progress.
progress.reconnecting: Lost touch with the server. Retrying…

summary.heading: Import finished
summary.body: {created, plural, =0 {No students added} one {# student added} other {# students added}}, {skipped, plural, =0 {none skipped} other {# skipped}}, {errors, plural, =0 {no errors} one {# error} other {# errors}}.
summary.reportBody: The error report lists each row that failed and why. Fix those rows and import them again.
summary.viewStudentsBody: See the students that were added.
summary.importAnotherBody: Start again with a new CSV file.

failed.heading: The import failed
failed.body: No more rows will be imported. Students added before the failure stay. Try again, or contact support if it keeps failing.

notFound.heading: Import not found
notFound.body: This link does not match an import of your institute.
